records.text: Owens alleged Israel took over TikTok after it became too pro-Palestine following October 7, describing the China-control rationale as a prelude to a group of Zionist investors buying it to eliminate pro-Palestine talk.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: We all know Israel took over TikTok. That was very, that was just done in our face. It became to pro-Palestine after October 7th. ... So they said, we're going to get rid of it because China controls it. And then they said, nevermind, we've got this group of Zionist investors and we're just going to buy it and get rid of pro-Palestine talk.

records.text: Owens said Zach Bryan and his entire band wore Free Palestine shirts at Gillette Stadium, that Bryan wore one on both nights, and that he broke the stadium attendance record previously held by Ed Sheeran on the second night.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Zach Bryan hits the stage and he is wearing a Free Palestine shirt. I mean, just a perfect response. ... free Palestine, just wearing the shirt. And I want to say, to be clear, everyone, his entire band, they were all wearing free Palestine shirts. ... I mean, this was tremendous. And the best part of the way that God works is not only He has two nights. He wore both nights free Palestine shirt. ... He broke the record, the attendance record at Gillette Stadium while wearing a free Palestine shirt for the second night in a row. ... And the record was previously held by Ed Sheeran.
